variable: 2022 median gross monthly household income, nominal RM, by residence
support: 92 matched mapped areas; most administrative districts; Perlis, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya each contribute one unit; includes Kecil Lojing. Equal observation weight, not household population weighting.
primary_weights: Symmetric union of 4 nearest interior representative points, then row-standardise for I/C. Binary graph for General G and Gi*, plus diagonal 1 for Gi*.
sensitivity_weights: Symmetric union 6NN; all other inputs unchanged.
local_null: Hold focal value fixed; sample k distinct other indices without replacement. Shared draws per focal unit across methods.
tails: Inclusive plus-one tails; local two-sided=min(1,2*min(lower,upper)); equality tolerance 1e-12. Global I/G upper, C lower.
adjustment: Separate 92-test BH families; exploratory under spatial dependence. Bonferroni comparison also reported.
